items.title: Dollar General (DG) After Instacart Delivery Push Has A Modest Undervalued Narrative
items.summary: Dollar General (DG) just rolled out a same day delivery partnership with Instacart that starts with roughly 7,000 stores and is planned to reach about 20,000 locations across 48 states this fall. These delivery and merchandising moves come after a mixed run for Dollar General’s stock, with the share price down 10.36% year to date but up 6.46% over the past 90 days, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 21.07% indicates improving momentum. items.title: Dollar General (DG) Brings Same Day Delivery to Thousands of Stores Nationwide
items.summary: Dollar General (NYSE:DG) has partnered with Instacart to offer same-day delivery of everyday essentials to customers across the United States. The service is scheduled to roll out across thousands of Dollar General locations in multiple states before expanding nationwide. Shoppers will be able to order a broad mix of household items and groceries from Dollar General through Instacart’s online and app-based platform. items.title: The Stock Market Faces a Triple Threat. It Can Emerge Victorious.
items.summary: The stock market is facing a triple threat to start the week, but there’s reason to hope it can overcome all three of its nemeses.  Oil prices and bond yields are putting stocks under pressure, while artificial-intelligence safety fears are also back.  Brent crude  prices have jumped around 4% back above $100 a barrel after the U.S. and Iran failed to broker a deal to end the war in the Middle East.
